results.title: Event-marketing firm Hive raises $27m Series B funding round - Music Ally
results.content:
Hive has helped its 1,600-plus venue, promoter and festival clients to sell more than $1bn of tickets using its event-marketing platform. Now it’s raised some money of its own to continue growing.

The company has raised $27m in a Series B funding round from investment firm Frontier Growth. What’s it going to use the money for? No surprises for guessing, in 2026, that AI will figure highly. [...] “AI-powered assistants that go beyond simplifying manual workflows by providing tools that empower busy event teams to get work done faster,” is what’s on the roadmap according to Hive’s funding announcement.

“Planned investments will focus on simplifying branded campaign preparation, reducing repetitive tasks and helping teams act on data insights to drive ticket sales, while keeping organisers in control of their voice and fan relationships.” [...] Skip to content

# DeepSeek Raises $15 Billion in Challenge to Leading US Labs

The Chinese AI pioneer DeepSeek has raised about 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) in its latest fundraising round, one of the country’s largest ever and a sign of the startup’s ambitions to compete globally with the likes of Anthropic PBC and OpenAI. [...] The Hangzhou-based firm boosted its financing target at least twice as it talked with investors, from 50 billion yuan to 80 billion yuan before reaching the final tally, according to people familiar with the matter. Battery pioneer Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd. and WeChat-operator Tencent Holdings Ltd. were among the biggest investors in the round, said the people, asking not to be named as the details aren’t public.

results.title: OpenAI nears funding round at $1.25T valuation led by UAE investors
results.content:
In this article

OpenAI is closing in on a funding round that could value the artificial intelligence giant at more than $1 trillion ahead of a potential initial public offering.

The San Francisco-based AI company is raising up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, according to people familiar with the deal, who asked not to be named because the details were confidential. That valuation does not include new capital raised. [...] Alongside the new investment, OpenAI is negotiating a commercial deal that would secure more computing capacity from the UAE, according to one person. The arrangement could help OpenAI secure additional computing power as it expands its AI business.

The fundraising also comes during a choppy time for tech markets. There have been jitters surrounding CoreWeave and questions about future financing conditions as interest rates rise. [...] Investors from the United Arab Emirates are leading the round alongside Coatue, according to people familiar with the deal.

OpenAI told investors Thursday that it aims to secure signatures by the end of next week. The final size of the round is still being determined, the people said.

The financing is being positioned as an "opportunistic" bridge ahead of a potential IPO, the people said. An OpenAI listing will likely come in 2027, CFO Sarah Friar has told employees.
